name: Ojou-sama to Aware na (Ko) Shitsuji
original_name: お嬢様と憐れな（こ）執事
source:
Rikudou is pretty much homeless because of his freewheeling father. Fortunately, his uncle took him in and arranged everything for him with the sole condition that he serves as a bridge between him and his rebellious daughters. He readily agreed, thinking that it was a common worry for a father, and thus his days of suffering began.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/05/04/may-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
